758:t_1:1011.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't say that. A journey's better with company.」

758:t_1:1012.en:
$$弁慶$$
「All right. This new world excites me too.」

758:t_1:1013.en:
$$隼人$$
「Besides, going into space with $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ should be an efficient way to research $$ゲッター線$$.」

758:t_1:1014.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Enough with the excuses! I'm counting on you two again!」

758:t_1:1015.en:
$$渓$$
「Our new battle begins in this hyperdimensional world.」

758:t_1:1016.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Whatever awaits us, we'll just keep moving forward.」

758:t_1:1017.en:
$$號$$
(That's right. That will is what brings the future... and evolution...)

758:t_1:1018.en:
$$號$$
(Guided by $$ゲッター線$$, Earth's humanity is now taking its first step toward a new stage...)

758:t_1:1022.en:
$$つばさ$$
「...You've made up your mind, then?」

758:t_1:1024.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm planning to join the deep-space exploration team with $$マジンガーＺ$$.」

758:t_1:1025.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Is that because of $$ゼウス$$?」

758:t_1:1026.en:
$$甲児$$
「During the super-dimensional repair, $$ゼウス$$ told me he'd be waiting in the vast universe, then left... Part of it is because those words stayed with me.」

758:t_1:1027.en:
$$甲児$$
「But that's not all. I want to go back to that galactic sea I saw during our battles.」

758:t_1:1030.en:
$$つばさ$$
「All right. Leave $$シロー$$ and your father to me.」

758:t_1:1032.en:
$$つばさ$$
「By the time you return from deep space, $$シロー$$ will be a fine young man and your father will have woken up.」

758:t_1:1034.en:
$$さやか$$
「Of course, I'm coming with you.」

758:t_1:1036.en:
$$さやか$$
「Because... if I wait for you, I... might be an old lady by then...」

758:t_1:1037.en:
$$ボス$$
「And let me tell you, I'm going too!」

758:t_1:1039.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「You'll regret it if you decide on impulse!」

758:t_1:1040.en:
$$ボス$$
「You idiots! The world stretches beyond space into other dimensions! How could I stay on Earth forever!?」

758:t_1:1041.en:
$$ボス$$
「The sea of space is my sea! We're going too, to make better men of ourselves!」

758:t_1:1043.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm counting on you from now on too, $$甲児$$.」

758:t_1:1044.en:
$$ボス$$
「I won't let you hog the spotlight forever!」

758:t_1:1045.en:
$$安$$
「Now that that's decided, we've got something to celebrate...!」

758:t_1:1046.en:
$$クロス$$
「Let's have a party to celebrate these youngsters setting out.」

758:t_1:1047.en:
$$お菊$$
「Take care, young master and young miss.」

758:t_1:1048.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Going into space means you'll represent Earth. I'm counting on you to do it right.」

758:t_1:1050.en:
$$ローレライ$$
「$$先生$$ says he'll put all his skill into preparing the food too.」

758:t_1:1051.en:
$$シロー$$
「Do your best, Big Bro! I'll protect Mom, Dad, and $$くろがね屋$$!」

758:t_1:1053.en:
$$甲児$$
(Wait for me, $$ゼウス$$... and everyone in $c... I'll head out into the vast universe with $$マジンガー$$ too.)

758:t_1:1054.en:
$$甲児$$
(Where there is hope, light is born... I'll illuminate humanity's future with the light of hope.)

758:t_1:1059.en:
$$谷川$$
「$$赤木$$... Your sighing is getting annoying.」

758:t_1:1061.en:
$$赤木$$
「I have to finish this mountain of paperwork today. Of course I'm going to sigh...」

758:t_1:1063.en:
$$石塚$$
「Operating $$ダイ・ガード$$ isn't the only job of Public Relations Division 2.」

758:t_1:1064.en:
$$田口$$
「Properly recording the damage caused by past $$界震$$s and other disasters is important work too.」

758:t_1:1065.en:
$$伊集院$$
「It's important. When you're prepared, there's nothing to worry about.」

758:t_1:1067.en:
$$横沢$$
「Move your hands before your mouth. If you don't finish today, you'll be working overtime.」

758:t_1:1070.en:
$$大杉$$
「It is indeed a $$界震$$ alert. Public Relations Division 2 is to stand by at the site as a precaution.」

758:t_1:1071.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! Let's go, $$いぶき$$ and $$青山$$!」

758:t_1:1073.en:
$$いぶき$$
「You'd never believe he was sighing nonstop at a mountain of paperwork just a moment ago.」

758:t_1:1074.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ exists to protect peace! How could I not get fired up when peace is in danger!?」

758:t_1:1075.en:
$$大杉$$
「Oh... $$赤木$$, take as much paperwork as you can to the site and work on it while you're on standby.」

758:t_1:1077.en:
$$青山$$
「Of course you have to. The deadline is today, after all.」

758:t_1:1078.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Come on, come on, there's no time to mope. Keep at it, $$赤木$$!」

758:t_1:1079.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! In that case, I'll take on the paperwork and the $$ヘテロダイン$$s all at once!」

758:t_1:1080.en:
$$青山$$
「It always comes back to that... The world has changed, but $$赤木$$ hasn't...」

758:t_1:1081.en:
$$いぶき$$
「It's all right. It's just like $$赤木$$... No, it's just like all of us.」

758:t_1:1082.en:
$$佐伯$$
「What are you all doing!? You've already been ordered to deploy!」

758:t_1:1083.en:
$$城田$$
「I'm counting on you. The site is near a residential area, and the evacuation isn't going well.」

758:t_1:1084.en:
$$赤木$$
「Leave it to us, $$城田$$. We're Public Relations Division 2, defenders of justice.」

758:t_1:1085.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, everyone! With the spirit of $c, we'll charge straight ahead for justice!」

758:t_1:1086.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even office workers can protect peace!」

758:t_1:1090.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「You're late, $$カレン$$! The graduation ceremony is about to start!」

758:t_1:1091.en:
$$カレン$$
「I just made it! And I got my credits just in time too!」

758:t_1:1092.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Still, it's strange. In the end, you're the only one graduating from the academy with me.」

758:t_1:1094.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「What are you planning to do after graduation, $$カレン$$? You didn't take any entrance exams...」

758:t_1:1096.en:
$$カレン$$
「I know. You're following Council President $$ミレイ$$ and becoming an assistant director at a TV station.」

758:t_1:1099.en:
$$カレン$$
「I haven't decided, but I intend to find something I can do for Japan in this new world.」
